focus: Symlink topology and runtime container asymmetry
noveltyJustification: Corrected the link-count scope and separated direct links, generated copies and dialect forks.
keyQuestions: What is the complete symlink topology, including relative versus absolute targets and runtime-consumed positions?
What are the seven runtime resolution contracts, and which paths are configurable versus hardcoded?
answeredQuestions: The mirror classes and runtime-specific container shapes are documented in the repository.

ruledOut.approach: Treat every runtime directory as a whole-tree symlink consumer
ruledOut.reason: Manifests document generated copies, real forks and discovery-only mirrors

keyFindings.finding: The resolved-link set is 427, with 253 internal .opencode links and 174 external runtime/spec links, all relative in the live tree.
Claude agents are a real dialect fork, Hermes skills are generated real copies, and Codex/Pi agents and prompts are generated outputs.
Cursor and Devin depend on runtime-native positions and shapes, while Devin has no command mirror.
